My dear [Bath Brick](../persons.html#1865)[^1]
Skelton was poet laureat to Henry VIII & Rector of Diss in Norfolk. I am afraid he was not a very respectable person & I do not know his poems.

Your ‘Tact’ is the chosen one this time[^2]
Yours very sincerely
Arachne

[^1]: \'Bath Brick\' made her first appearance in MP in May 1876 as a participant in the [Spider](../others.html#116) competitions, and continued to take part until 1896.

[^2]: ‘Define Tact’ was one of the Spider questions for December 1877.

Bath Brick’s answer was chosen for publication in the issue of February 1878.
